scripts.test:docker: npm run test:docker:unit && npm run test:docker:e2e
scripts.test:docker:unit: npm run test:docker:backend && npm run test:docker:frontend
scripts.test:docker:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --wait backend-e2e frontend-e2e && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --build --rm --no-deps e2e; status=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down --remove-orphans; exit $status
